notes: A start and finish read from the map's destinations (chk-maps run 74). The spawns stand over a teleport to `cp1`, so a player lands there and the start is round it. Checkpoints cp2..cp14 are named-filter pits (the name `fcpN` is set by a checkpoint trigger and stays), kept as pits. The finish is the one teleport to the `finish` destination. Not published.
